summary: Phase 11 (Origin-Edge Invariant -- Step Preservation) COMPLETE against the v2 plan. Landed in Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/LoopChecking.lean: (1) modalStepBranchS4Keyed_preserves_keysOriginS4 -- the unordered single-step preservation lemma for keysOriginS4 (Phase 10's origin-edge invariant), covering all 14 sf.sign/sf.formula combinations: the 12 non-minting shapes uniformly via modalApplyOneS4Keyed_nonMint_snd_eq_acc (newAcc=acc) composed with keysOriginS4_mono_branch/_mono_acc, and the box-negative/diamond-positive minting shapes' blocked (edge added, no new key, same monotonicity argument) and unblocked (a genuinely new key established by direct construction from successorBirthContent's insert-head witness pair) sub-cases, each proved individually. (2) modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_preserves_keysOriginS4 -- verbatim ordered-driver transcription via modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_selected_mem/_branch_superset. (3) modalStepBranchS4Keyed_result_acc_eq -- one small new reusable private helper mirroring the existing modalStepBranchS4Keyed_result_keys_eq, extracting the accessibility component result-shape-agnostically. (4) modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_preserves_S4LoopInv extended with a fourth hypothesis (keysOriginS4 b acc keys) and fourth conclusion conjunct (keysOriginS4 b' newAcc keys' over every produced branch), threaded exactly like keysWorldsKnown/worldsContiguousS4. The S4LoopInv struct and the unordered wrapper modalStepBranchS4_preserves_S4LoopInv are byte-for-byte unchanged. No external call sites of the ordered wrapper existed yet to update. Full breadth covered in a single dispatch (no contingency split needed). No empirical termination-vs-completeness signal surfaced this phase -- purely structural proof, no fuel/measure argument touched; the standing central prediction stays live and unconfirmed.
decisions_made: keysOriginS4's extended wrapper hypothesis/conjunct carries no phi_0 parameter, matching Phase 10's already-landed phi_0-free signature for keysOriginS4 itself (unusedArguments-linter-forced). The plan's literal task text proposed `keysOriginS4 phi_0 b' newAcc keys'`; the landed shape is `keysOriginS4 b' newAcc keys'`. Shape adjustment only, not a weakening.

The 12 non-minting shapes were closed via modalApplyOneS4Keyed_nonMint_snd_eq_acc (needs accTargetsKnown b acc, threaded as a new haK hypothesis on both preservation lemmas) rather than the later-defined modalApplyOneS4Keyed_hasEdge_mono, to avoid a forward-reference ordering problem: the wrapper theorem this phase extends (line ~7529) sits BEFORE modalApplyOneS4Keyed_hasEdge_mono (line ~8157) in the file. Using the nonMint_snd_eq_acc route (defined earlier, ~line 4026) let the new preservation lemmas land at the natural insertion point (immediately after keysWorldsKnown's ordered preservation lemma) without relocating any existing declaration.

Added one new small private helper, modalStepBranchS4Keyed_result_acc_eq (dual of the existing modalStepBranchS4Keyed_result_keys_eq), to extract the accessibility component result-shape-agnostically for the non-mint branch, avoiding a 3-way case split on RuleResult purely for that fact.
flagged_theorem_changes: No landed declaration (Phases 1-10) modified. modalStepBranchS4KeyedOrdered_preserves_S4LoopInv gained a new hypothesis and a new conclusion conjunct (additive signature change, no existing conjunct altered); its own body was re-derived accordingly. modalStepBranchS4_preserves_S4LoopInv (unordered) and the S4LoopInv struct itself are untouched, confirmed via grep and direct reading.
dead_ends: Do not call modalApplyOneS4Keyed_hasEdge_mono (line ~8157) from a lemma placed before it in the file -- Lean has no forward references. Use modalApplyOneS4Keyed_nonMint_snd_eq_acc (line ~4026) instead for the non-mint newAcc=acc fact, which is available earlier.

Do not do `rw [hpair] at hsf; dsimp only at hsf` once, globally, right after `rcases hpair`, before the by_cases on mint shape -- this consumes the substitution opportunity the mint branches need AFTER rewriting sf to its concrete literal form via hsfeq. Each branch (both mint sub-branches and the non-mint branch) must do its own local `rw [hpair] at hsf; dsimp only at hsf` at the point where sf is already in its final (possibly still-abstract, for non-mint) form.

Do not `subst hb'` naively when `hb' : b' = b` (both sides plain local variables, as in the blocked-mint sub-case where the branch is unchanged) -- Lean's subst may eliminate the OUTER variable `b` instead of `b'`, breaking every later reference to `b`. Fix: `symm at hb'` first, forcing subst to eliminate `b'` and keep `b`.
